content_sections.heading: A&N Administration Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 2-65(A)/2026-PWD)/765 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download A&N Administration notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officer of Central Government, State Governments, UT Administration, Autonomous or Statutory Organizations, PSUs or Recognized University/Institute/Research Institution; Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; OR five years' service on regular basis in Level-9 or Level-10 in the Pay Matrix or equivalent; Bachelor's Degree in Architecture from a recognized University or Institute; Fellowship or membership of the Indian Institute of Architects; Certificate/Diploma Course in Auto CAD, Archi. CAD, Revit or any other Software Application for Architectural illustration or Architectural Rendering Experience: One year experience in Town Planning/Civic Designing/Building Control Regulations Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Only officers who can be relieved immediately on selection should apply Applications must be forwarded through proper channel by the employer

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected officer may opt for pay fixation in the deputation post or parent pay plus deputation allowance, as per Ministry of Finance orders. Deputation (ISTC) initially for two (02) years, which may be extended in accordance with the rules Period of deputation (ISTC) including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed 4 years Selected officer shall not be allowed to withdraw or refuse to join Sponsoring authority must release the selected officer within a month of the appointment letter/order

content_sections.heading: How Will A&N Administration Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Assessment of the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee Information in the Curriculum Vitae and documents on Essential Qualification/Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data in prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) in duplicate, signed and forwarded through proper channel Vigilance clearance certificate Integrity certificate Statement of penalty (Major/Minor) imposed, if any ACR dossier or ACRs for last five years; photocopies attested on each page by officer not below Under Secretary rank Latest salary slip if the organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for A&N Administration Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram, or download it from andamannicobar.gov.in or www.apwd.and.nic.in. Fill the bio-data in the Annexure-I proforma in duplicate and sign it. Attach vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, statement of penalty and ACRs for the last five years. Get the application forwarded through proper channel by the employer with the employer's certification. Application must reach the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Sri Vijaya Puram within 60 days from publication of the Vacancy Notice. Make sure it reaches by 18 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications or those without the complete set of essential documents shall be rejected Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently
